# R.R.M External Cleaning Specialist — llms.txt

> Professional exterior cleaning company based in Newton-le-Willows, Merseyside (WA12 8QY).
> Serving Merseyside, Greater Manchester, Cheshire and West Lancashire since 2016.
> Fully insured. Available 24/7. Free no-obligation quotes: 07845 463877.

## About
R.R.M External Cleaning Specialist provides driveway cleaning, roof soft washing,
render (K-Rend/monocouche) cleaning, gutter clearing, patio cleaning, window cleaning
(water-fed pole), pressure/jet washing and commercial exterior cleaning for
residential and commercial clients across North West England.
